summary: Fifteen tiles. One little challenge.
description: Slide the numbered tiles into order, leaving the empty space at the bottom right. Every shuffled board can be solved. Your puzzle is saved after every move.

summary: A pocket canvas for bright ideas.
description: Draw with your stylus in six colors. Choose the eraser to tidy up, or Clear to start again. Your canvas is saved as you draw, ready whenever inspiration returns.

summary: A classic minefield, made pocket-sized.
description: Clear the board without uncovering a mine. Tap to dig, hold to flag, and tap a satisfied number to clear its neighbors. Choose Beginner or Intermediate and beat your best time. Your game is saved after every move.

summary: Klondike on the go. Deal yourself in.
description: Build four foundations from ace to king in classic Klondike Solitaire. Choose draw one or draw three, drag cards or tap to move them, and undo a move when you need to. Your deal is saved after every move.

summary: Live CPU, memory and running tasks.
description: Watch CPU and memory history, inspect running tasks and their threads, and end managed apps with confirmation. Pause to inspect a sample. System services stay protected. CPU and task features require an updated Glaze OS; memory and uptime work on older builds.

summary: Instant messages, the classic way.
description: Sign on to an AIM revival server or your own OSCAR server and chat with your buddies. See who is online, away or idle, keep your Buddy List on the server, set an away message that answers for you, and hear doors open as friends sign on. Requires an Ethernet card.

summary: Email on the go with Gmail.
description: Read, search and send Gmail over IMAPS and SMTPS with an App Password or your own mail server. Browse Inbox, Starred, Sent, Drafts, All Mail and Trash, star or archive messages, and keep recent mail cached for offline reading. Requires an Ethernet card.

summary: Classic 8-bit NES games in your pocket.
description: Play NES cartridges with the BE-300 buttons: arrows for the D-pad, OK and Esc for A and B, and Start and Select from the pause menu. Copy your own .nes files to Documents or a card, or try the included Glaze demo. Battery saves are kept, and Home suspends your game. No commercial games are included.

summary: Game Boy and Game Boy Color, anywhere.
description: Play Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges with the BE-300 buttons. Copy your own .gb and .gbc files to Documents or a card, or try the included Glaze demos. Battery saves are kept, and Home suspends your game. No commercial games or boot ROMs are included.

summary: Sega Master System, made pocket-sized.
description: Play Sega Master System cartridges with the BE-300 buttons. Copy your own .sms files to Documents or a card, or try the included Glaze demo. Cartridge saves are kept, and Home suspends your game. No commercial games or BIOS are included.

summary: 16-bit Genesis games on the go.
description: Play Sega Genesis (Mega Drive) cartridges with FM sound and the BE-300 buttons, and choose which buttons OK and Esc press. Copy your own .gen, .md or .bin files to Documents or a card, or try the included Glaze demo. Cartridge saves are kept, and Home suspends your game. No commercial games are included.

summary: Sega Game Gear, in full color.
description: Play Sega Game Gear cartridges with the BE-300 buttons, shown full width on the screen. Copy your own .gg files to Documents or a card, or try the included Glaze demo. Cartridge saves are kept, and Home suspends your game. No commercial games or boot ROMs are included.

summary: TurboGrafx-16 HuCards, ready to play.
description: Play TurboGrafx-16 and PC Engine HuCards with the BE-300 buttons: OK and Esc for I and II, and Run and Select from the pause menu. Copy your own .pce files to Documents or a card, or try the included Glaze demo. Saves are kept, and Home suspends your game. No BIOS, commercial cards or CD games are included.

summary: SomaFM radio, live on your Glaze.
description: Listen to 51 SomaFM stations, save your favorites, and see the current song. Music keeps playing when you return Home or open another app. An unofficial player for personal listening; SomaFM is listener supported. Requires an Ethernet card and a Glaze OS version with radio playback support.

summary: Chat on your Glaze with your ChatGPT account.
description: Send text messages using your ChatGPT account's Codex access. Sign in with a device code or import a Codex login from your computer, then chat directly from Glaze. Requires a network connection, an eligible account and an updated Glaze OS with TLS support.

summary: Classic Doom with pocket-sized controls and sound.
description: Play classic single-player Doom with BE-300 buttons, sound effects and save games. Supply your own compatible Doom, Doom II or Freedoom IWAD in Documents or on a card, then select it in the app. Game data is supplied separately. Requires an updated Glaze OS.

summary: Stack falling blocks and clear the lines.
description: Rotate and drop falling pieces to complete lines. Preview the next piece, hold one for later, and follow the ghost to place it precisely. Play with the BE-300 buttons, no stylus needed. Speed rises every ten lines, and your best score is kept. Your game is saved when you go Home.

summary: Steer, eat, grow. Don't bite your tail.
description: Guide the snake around the board with the arrow buttons, eat to grow longer, and avoid the walls and your own body. The pace picks up every five bites, and your best score is kept. Your game is saved when you go Home.

summary: One button. Endless gaps. How far can you fly?
description: Press OK or Up to flap and glide between the pipes. Each pair you pass scores a point, and the scrolling speeds up as you go. Your best score is kept, and your game is saved when you go Home.

summary: Offline maps that know where you are.
description: Follow your position on offline map packs with a CompactFlash GPS receiver. Drag to pan, double-tap or use + and - to zoom, and tap Locate to follow again. The GPS page shows your fix and every satellite. Record keeps a track in the background and saves it as GPX. Put .gzmap packs in /Maps or /Card/Maps.

summary: A full game of chess against a pocket engine.
description: Play White against a compact chess engine at Weak, Normal or Strong. Tap a piece and then its square, or use the arrow keys and OK. Legal moves are marked, the last move is tinted and a king in check glows red. Castling, en passant and promotion are all here. Your game is saved when you go Home.

summary: Pegs and links. Bridge the board before the computer does.
description: Place pegs to link the top and bottom of the board while the computer races left to right. Each peg builds every knight-move link it has earned, and links can never cross. Tap near a dot or use the arrow keys and OK. Undo, three strengths and a saved game are always a pause away.

summary: Paddle, ball and a wall of bricks.
description: Slide the paddle with a finger or the arrow keys and keep the ball in play. Nine levels cycle through five layouts, with tough orange bricks and steel that never breaks. Where the ball meets the paddle sets its angle, and it speeds up as you go. Your best score is kept, and your game is saved when you go Home.

summary: Fly through wave after wave of enemy planes.
description: Steer with the arrows or a finger and your wing guns fire on their own. Weaving fighters, fast divers and heavy bombers come in waves, each one faster than the last. Three lives, a wave bonus and a best score to beat. Your game is saved when you go Home.

summary: Clear the maze before the ghosts catch you.
description: Steer with the arrow keys or a swipe and eat every pellet in the maze. Four ghosts hunt you, each in its own way. Grab a power pellet to turn the tables, chase down fruit for bonus points and slip through the tunnel to escape. Your best score is kept, and your game is saved when you go Home.
